I go to sleep, Sparedevil, I wake up, Sparedevil, I go to work, Sparedevil, I have dinner, Sparedevil. Life comes and goes, but Sparedevil will always remain.

The word "survivors" in the title would lead you to believe that vampire survivors is the core influence behind Sparedevil, but actually I think it shares more with the likes of Devil Daggers and Hyper Demon. There's no meta progression in the game, you progress by becoming more familiar with the game's patterns. It's a fun mashup of ideas and I like the challenge it presents you to master its movement mechanics. Hitting strikes on enemies is very satisfying and slam dunking an exploding bowling ball on a group of enemies is funny. My only sticking point is how visually overwhelming it can be to pick out high value targets from the crowd of enemies.

Just sat down and played this game for the first time, almost 2 hours came and went and I had no idea. Game kinda just throws you into the deep end and doesn't explain any mechanics outside of basic movement and attacking, but I had a lot of fun piecing it together. The game is kinda wonky, the visuals are a little lacking, and in my one and only play session I found some buggy janky behavior and yet all of it work in favor of the game, adding to its charm. The designs are so silly and fun, the ball faces are cute and zany, and above all else the game is shockingly fun. It gets really addictive and engaging once you get into it, I'm looking forward to playing again tomorrow morning :)
